description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Clear functional corridor connecting zones. Kitchen: unclear, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: living-dominant, kitchen on side wall. Seating: sofa and lounge seating arranged around a central coffee table in the open living zone on the right side, facing inward. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is blank wall, L-shaped corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Double bedroom closest to entry — lighter acoustic separation from the arrival zone. Secondary bedroom 1 — accessed via own door off corridor. The single bedroom can function as a dedicated home office, hobby room, guest room, or children's bedroom. 0 of 1 have a desk visible in plan. Single bedroom use options: children's bedroom / dedicated home office / hobby or creative studio / guest room. Storage: no wardrobe — very limited storage. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower and toilet); separate WC. One bathroom plus separate WC — one person can shower while another uses the toilet. Simultaneous showering not possible. Suits: couples needing a dedicated home office or hobby room; small families with one child. Not suitable for: households needing ample storage (no wardrobes shown); remote workers requiring a dedicated desk or home office; large families needing more than two bedrooms; anyone needing a bathtub (only shower bathroom).
